nodes.rationale: Chosen order OPSD replay, forecasting, grid health stress, optimization dispatch, prosumer decisions, trading clear, regulation audit makes each agent decision visible in the dashboard decision log.

nodes.label: Grid Health Stress Threshold GRIDMESH_STRESS_KW
nodes.rationale: GRIDMESH_STRESS_KW default 6.0 kW is calibrated to the demo slice so stress fires on the evening peak only.

nodes.label: Stress Calibration 6.0 kW Evening Peak Only
nodes.norm_label: stress calibration 6.0 kw evening peak only
nodes.rationale: 6.0 kW threshold calibrated so only 17 of 96 ticks stress with peak 7.07 kW at 20:00, isolating the evening peak for the demo story.

nodes.label: BUG-001 No compliance flag fires on organic data
nodes.norm_label: bug-001 no compliance flag fires on organic data
nodes.rationale: Do not lower MAX_QTY_KWH to fake a flag; instead add an LLM fairness-dispute path plus a demo rogue-bid injector so Regulation looks non-decorative without gaming the metric.

nodes.label: LOOP-002 Midday surplus mostly wasted
nodes.rationale: 240 kWh PV versus 57 kWh load with trades capped at buyer demand leaves excess nowhere to go, so Optimization should charge storage and EV from surplus once battery state is threaded through.

nodes.label: Rogue Bid Demo Injector Mechanism
nodes.rationale: A demo flag injector is preferred over lowering thresholds because it produces at least one genuine compliance flag for the PRD success metric.

nodes.label: LOOP-004 Silent LLM fallback
nodes.rationale: Missing or bad API keys degrade silently to cached responses, risking a demo that succeeds on rails unnoticed, so warn in logs and surface provider status on health.

nodes.label: Groq NVIDIA NIM LLM with Cached Fallbacks

nodes.label: Offline Demo Resilience via Cached LLM Fallbacks
nodes.norm_label: offline demo resilience via cached llm fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Without GROQ_API_KEY or NIM_API_KEY the LLM agents use cached responses in data/fallbacks so the demo survives offline, per PRD NFR.

nodes.label: LOOP-003 Ledger in-memory only
nodes.rationale: Trade history resets on restart so SQLite persistence is planned pre-Phase 4 as audit durability, with hash-chain replacing it in Phase 4.

nodes.label: TradeLedger Interface Hash-Chain Deferred
nodes.rationale: Ledger interface exists now as TradeLedger in backend/app/ledger/interface.py while hash-chain durability is deferred to Phase 4 to unblock Phase 1.
